lines: Main bhool jaaun tumhein, ab yahi munaasib hai
couplets.en: It would be best now if I forgot you.

lines: Main bhool jaaun tumhein, ab yahi munaasib hai
Magar bhulaana bhi chaahoon to kis tarah bhooloon?
couplets.en: I ought to forget you now, but how could I, even if I wished to?

lines: Magar bhulaana bhi chaahoon to kis tarah bhooloon?
Ki tum to phir bhi haqeeqat ho, koi khwaab nahin
couplets.en: Even if I wished to forget you, how could I, when you are real and no mere dream?

lines: Yahaan to dil ka ye aalam hai, kya kahoon?
Kambakht, bhula saka na ye wo silsila jo tha hi nahin
couplets.en: What can I say of this poor heart, still unable to forget a story that never was?

lines: Bhula saka na ye wo silsila jo tha hi nahin
Wo ek khayaal jo aawaaz tak gaya hi nahin
couplets.en: My heart could never forget what never was, that one thought that never found a voice.

lines: Wo ek baat jo main keh nahin saka tumse
Wo ek rabt jo hum mein kabhi raha hi nahin
couplets.en: There was the one thing I could never tell you, and the bond we never shared.

lines: Mujhe hai yaad wo sab jo kabhi hua hi nahin
couplets.en: I remember everything that never happened.

lines: Agar ye haal hai dil ka to koi samjhaaye
Agar ye haal hai dil ka to koi samjhaaye
couplets.en: If this is how the heart is, let someone explain it to me.

lines: Tumhein bhulaana bhi chaahoon to kis tarah bhooloon?
couplets.en: Even if I wanted to forget you, how could I?

lines: Ki tum to phir bhi haqeeqat ho, koi khwaab nahin
Ki tum to phir bhi haqeeqat ho, koi khwaab nahin
couplets.en: After all, you are real and no mere dream.

lines: Ki tum to phir bhi haqeeqat ho, koi khwaab nahin
couplets.en: After all, you are real and no mere dream.
